is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F-kdr) and GSTe2 L119F (page 4, 5, 8, 9, 10).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 and Table 4 provide genotype counts/frequencies (OR, CI, P-values) for L119F-GSTe2 and L1014F-kdr, and Figures 5 and 6 provide genotype distribution bar charts with sample sizes (n) for alive/dead, blood-fed/unfed, and room/veranda.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from Elende and Nkolondom in Cameroon (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study evaluating IRS efficacy and resistance markers in experimental huts.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies locations as Elende (3°41′57.27’’N, 11°33′28.46’’E) and Nkolondom (3°57′18″N, 11°29′36″E) (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between September 2021 and March 2022 (page 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new experimental hut trials and collections.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in the main text tables and figures.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of Fludora Fusion (clothianidin + deltamethrin) in experimental huts in Cameroon against pyrethroid-resistant An. funestus and An. gambiae. It also genotyped L1014F-kdr and L119F-GSTe2 to assess their impact on insecticide efficacy.
